_comment_adCode: Global Ad Code — loads sitewide, every page, every open. Paste a full <script>…</script> tag as a string.
_comment_alwaysLoad: Always Load — sitewide, every page, every open, but NOT an ad (e.g. anti-adblock script). Paste a full <script>…</script> tag as a string.
_comment_mobileAdSlot: Mobile Ad Slot — shown only on mobile, in header/footer and every 1 tool in the grid. Paste the ad snippet as a string.
_comment_desktopAdSlot: Desktop Ad Slot — shown only on desktop, in header/footer and every 2 tools in the grid. Paste the ad snippet as a string.
_comment_advertisementsInnerCodes: List of ad codes that auto-spread through page content (top / middle / end). Add as many as you want — spacing recalculates automatically. This is the DEFAULT list used when a tool page doesn't set its own in front-matter.
_comment_cookies: Cookie-consent banner text and button labels — shown on every page until the user accepts or declines.
cookieText: We use cookies to keep EarthInsider Tools working smoothly and to understand basic usage. No personal text you enter into any tool is ever stored.
